description: Single-VM scenario delivering an Ubuntu LTS host with the Docker baseline (docker, docker compose, zsh, curl, git, jq, vim, network utils) on vmbr142, then deploying the misp-standalone docker-compose stack from range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/misp-standalone/ via the shared bundle bundles/admin/software.install.misp_standalone/. MISP IS the workload of this scenario (always deployed, no INSTALL_MISP flag). The lab VM is admin-misp-standalone (VMID 1180, IP 192.168.142.180). Optional admin-wazuh VM (VMID 1187, IP 192.168.142.187, vmbr142, gated by INSTALL_WAZUH, default off) deploys a Wazuh SIEM server + agent on admin-misp-standalone.
